title: Finite-stage tensor and adjunction normalization for the common proper pull/push
statement: In the finite-field geometric-base-change setting of [def-sf-native-proper-projection-comparison-data], let p be proper and fix one finite coefficient field E in the common-stage system [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Write F for its coefficient field and IX,IY for the finite-stage inclusions. There are a right adjoint G of rationalDerivedPullback, a specified adjunction, tensor inclusion isomorphisms tX,tY, and pull/push inclusion isomorphisms a,b comparing the finite adjunction with geometricCommonStageAdjunction. The tensor square identifies the included canonical rational pullback/tensor comparison with the canonical common-stage one, using tX,tY,a. The counit square is IX(ε_K)=a_(G K) followed by commonPull(b_K) followed by the common counit at IX K. These are normalization equations only: no projection map and no assertion of projection invertibility is included.

proof.text: Localize the integral pull/direct adjunction at each finite coefficient field. Finite scalar change has invertible right-adjoint mates. Their counit equation and coherence descend the adjunction through the common-stage quotient. Uniqueness of the right adjoint identifies its descended right functor with the specified geometricCommonStageDirectImage and supplies the displayed counit equation.

The finite-stage tensor and pullback representative formulas give tX,tY and a. Their naturality is the scalar-extension associativity/cocycle equation. Insert these formulas in the defining representative of canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor: both paths are the included canonicalRationalPullbackTensor with the same endpoint comparisons. Cancel adjacent inverse comparisons. This tensor calculation uses no projection invertibility.

lean.statement:
theorem properCommonProjection_finiteStageComparison [IsProper p]
    (hl : IsUnit (l : AlgebraicClosure k₀))
    [∀ x : (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber,
      Invertible (l : (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber,
      Invertible (l : (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber.residueField y)]
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) :
    let F := AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E
    let X := (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
    let W := (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber
    let f := NativeBaseChange.geometricMap k₀ p
    let IX := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := X) E
    let IY := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := W) E
    let FC := commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) f
    let GC := properCommonPush k₀ l p hl
    let TCX := commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X
    let TCY := commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) W
    ∃ (G : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l F X ⥤ sfRationalConstructibleCategory l F W)
      (adj : rationalDerivedPullback l F f ⊣ G)
      (tX : (IX.prod IX) ⋙ TCX ≅ rationalDerivedTensor l F X ⋙ IX)
      (tY : (IY.prod IY) ⋙ TCY ≅ rationalDerivedTensor l F W ⋙ IY)
      (a : rationalDerivedPullback l F f ⋙ IX ≅ IY ⋙ FC)
      (b : G ⋙ IY ≅ IX ⋙ GC),
      (∀ P Q : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l F W,
        IX.map (canonicalRationalPullbackTensor l F f P Q).hom ≫
          tX.inv.app ((rationalDerivedPullback l F f).obj P,
            (rationalDerivedPullback l F f).obj Q) ≫
          TCX.map (Prod.mkHom (a.hom.app P) (a.hom.app Q)) =
        a.hom.app ((rationalDerivedTensor l F W).obj (P, Q)) ≫
          FC.map (tY.inv.app (P, Q)) ≫
          (canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) f
            (IY.obj P) (IY.obj Q)).hom) ∧
      ∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l F X,
        IX.map (adj.counit.app K) = a.hom.app (G.obj K) ≫
          FC.map (b.hom.app K) ≫
          (geometricCommonStageAdjunction l (PadicAlgCl l)
            (AlgebraicClosure k₀) hl f).counit.app (IX.obj K)
